info.title: RustNetRuntime
info.description: RustNetRuntime: a .NET runtime (RustCLR) written in Rust. The rustnet command builds, runs, debugs, profiles, inspects and disassembles .NET assemblies on RustCLR, on Windows, Linux and macOS (x64 and arm64). Built by Gravicode Studios, led by Kang Fadhil.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: rustnet — the RustNet Toolchain for RustCLR

commands.name: capabilities
commands.description: Report which runtime features are implemented.

commands.name: disasm
commands.description: Disassemble method bodies to IL. `filter` matches Type.Method.

commands.name: jit
commands.description:
Report which methods the native code generator compiles, and why it
declines the rest. A declined method is interpreted, not a failure.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Load the assembly and report every member that will not resolve.
